hypothesis: After invalid-neighbour removal, the remaining fixed-threshold gap is partly caused by query-wise upper-tail shape: a single scene maximum is not a stable operating-point anchor. A target-blind recursive-upper-Otsu split can set the operating point while preserving all within-query rankings.

candidate_family.stage_1_excluded_before_metrics: A score-only audit showed that the first split retains 10-38 percent of primitives for several broad queries; it does not isolate the response tail and is therefore not a bounded object-support candidate.
candidate_family.formula: piecewise-linear monotone map [0, adaptive_threshold, 1] to [0, 0.6, 1] independently per query

selection_rule.choose_on_development_scene: higher frozen exact mIoU; tie within 0.001 resolves to fewer stages
selection_rule.promotion: selected global variant must improve macro mIoU across all three independent scenes and be non-regressive by more than 0.002 on at least two of three scenes
selection_rule.failure: reject adaptive calibration and retain the continuous valid-domain parent
